name: The Bam Bam Room
description: Dedicated mahjong parlor in Leawood (opened Sept 2025) with open play, beginner lessons (Mahjong 101 + 102), day and night leagues, and a shop. Own site lists bookable Open Play, lessons and leagues but does not say American/NMJL on the pages read; local press (KCUR) describes it as American mahjong.
schedule: Open Play, Mahjong 101 + 102 lessons, day/night leagues; dates and times not shown on the home page
